meta.title: 面试必考题：你对公司了解多少
meta.title_en: The Must-Ask Interview Question: What Do You Know About Us

scenes.title_cn: 必考题与三种丢分信号
scenes.title_en: A must-ask question and three red flags
scenes.context: 讲者指出这是面试必考题，答「不了解」等于暴露三个负面信息。
sentences: 公司了解多少呢，这次面试的有必考题，这问题回答不好会直接影响你的面试结果。
"What do you know about us?" is a must-ask interview question, and a poor answer can sink your whole interview.
必考题：a must-ask question
虽然这个问题相当于是开卷考试，但还是会有不少小伙伴丢分。
It's basically an open-book test, yet plenty of people still lose points on it.
开卷考试：an open-book test
我确实不太了解你们公司，你们约我面试我就过来了。
"Honestly, I don't know much about your company — you invited me, so I just came."
不太了解：don't know much about
paraphrase: 答不了解=三个负面信号
Saying "I don't know you" signals three red flags.
必考题虽是开卷→仍然大量丢分
Open-book, but people still bomb it.
scenes.speak: "What do you know about us?" is a must-ask interview question, and a poor answer can sink your whole interview. It's basically an open-book test, yet plenty of people still lose points on it. "Honestly, I don't know much about your company — you invited me, so I just came."

scenes.context: 讲者给出调研框架的三个基础项：行业业务、产品类型、产品特点。
sentences: 基础项的第一问：搞清楚公司属于什么行业、做什么业务、盈利模式是什么样子的。
First basic: pin down the industry, the business, and how they make money.
盈利模式：how they make money
基础项的第二问：搞清楚它有哪些产品或者服务，类型有哪些。
Second basic: figure out what products or services they offer and what categories they fall into.
产品或服务：products or services
基础项的第三问：搞清楚它的产品或者服务都有一些什么样子的特点。
Third basic: identify what makes their products or services distinctive.
特点：distinctive / features
paraphrase: 三基础=公司靠什么活、拿什么见人、凭什么被记住
The three basics cover survival, offerings, and differentiators.
基础项是及格线→先补齐再谈加分
Nail the basics before chasing bonus points.
scenes.speak: First basic: pin down the industry, the business, and how they make money. Second basic: figure out what products or services they offer and what categories they fall into. Third basic: identify what makes their products or services distinctive.

scenes.title_en: Three bonus points and your interest
scenes.context: 讲者给出加分项：业绩口碑、竞争对手、相对优劣势，并强调最后要落到自己的兴趣点。
sentences: 加分项的第一个维度：这家公司业绩做得怎么样、口碑怎么样。
First bonus: how well the company performs and how it's regarded.
口碑：how it's regarded
加分项的第二个维度：它的竞争对手有哪些。
Second bonus: who their competitors are.
竞争对手：competitors
机会往往是留给有准备的人，不辜负每一场面试。
Opportunity favors the prepared — don't waste a single interview.
留给有准备的人：favors the prepared
paraphrase: 加分项=做得怎么样、和谁竞争、凭什么赢
Bonus points: performance, rivals, and edge over them.
潜台词→你对公司哪些方面感兴趣
The real question is what draws you to them.
scenes.speak: First bonus: how well the company performs and how it's regarded. Second bonus: who their competitors are. Opportunity favors the prepared — don't waste a single interview.

practice: I've looked into the industry and how the company makes money.
Their products stand out because of the after-sales model.
Compared to their rivals, they're stronger on pricing but weaker on reach.
What draws me here is their direction in AI-driven products.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：This company is in the automobile industry.
✓ 地道说法：They operate in the automotive space.
in the automotive space 比 in the industry 更口语。
✕ 直译腔：What is your profit pattern?
✓ 地道说法：How does the company make money?
盈利模式别用 profit pattern，用 how they make money。
✕ 直译腔：I am not quite familiar with your company.
✓ 地道说法：I haven't looked into your company as much as I should have.
直接说 not familiar 很生硬，用 haven't looked into 承认但表达改进。
✕ 直译腔：Opportunity always stays for prepared people.
✓ 地道说法：Opportunity favors the prepared.
favors the prepared 是固定表达。
shifts: 被问公司了解多少就答不了解
用 3+3 框架提前做结构化调研
调研=行业、业务、产品、竞对的理解
最后落一句「为什么我对这家公司感兴趣」
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「开转考试」校正为「开卷考试」，「性重重」校正为「兴冲冲」，「价品项」校正为「加分项」，「产地多长时间」校正为「成立多长时间」，「价分项」校正为「加分项」，「纬度」校正为「维度」，「竞品」校正为「竞品（竞争对手）」，「上一期信息」校正为「这些信息」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
